# Sanitized Codex TUI screen while a structured question (request_user_input) is pending.
# Captured 2026-11-06 with tmux capture-pane from a native Bridge mission; paths and addresses generic.

State 1: question collapsed under the composer (provider idle, waiting):

• Queued follow-up inputs
  ? 1 question
    shift+← to answer
› Ask Codex to do anything
  GPT-6-Luna high · ~/dev/<worktree> · <branch>
  ? for shortcuts

State 2: after shift+Left, the question is expanded:

• Queued follow-up inputs
  Please unplug the Pi's data/power USB cable, wait 10 seconds, and reconnect it. It stopped answering on Wi-Fi
  after the requested DHCP renewal; its hostname change is saved, but the interface has not returned. I cannot
  switch USB power under the mission's power rule. Reply when it is powered again.
  › 1. I'll reconnect it now
    2. I can't reconnect it right now
    3. Other
  enter submit   ^] skip   shift+→ main prompt

With two questions the header reads "? 2 questions" and the expanded view shows "1 of 2" above the question title,
and the hint line adds "shift+← next question". While the provider is still working the composer area shows
"• Working (... • esc to interrupt)" above "• Queued follow-up inputs".
Codex also records each pending question in its session JSONL (~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl) as a
request_user_input tool call; prefer that structured source over screen scraping where the session file is known.
